entities.name: Thiophene carboxylic acid
observations: Decoded structure: O=CC=1SC=C(Br)C=1C(=O)O, equivalent canonical SMILES O=Cc1scc(Br)c1C(=O)O; contains carboxylic acid, aldehyde, and aryl bromide.

entities.name: Ethyl ester formation
observations: Potassium carbonate promotes carboxylate formation, followed by SN2 alkylation with ethyl iodide; predicted transformation is CO2H to CO2Et without changing the aldehyde, thiophene sulfur, or aryl bromide.

entities.name: Ethyl thiophene carboxylate
observations: Predicted product canonical SMILES: CCOC(=O)c1scc(Br)c1C=O. Formula C8H7BrO3S; calculated molecular weight about 263.11 g/mol.
